inputs.userGoal: create the required bicep templates for deployment
subGoals: Approved: new App Service, managed identity and private Azure Table Storage; no Cosmos DB or unnecessary Key Vault.
Templates and documentation only; do not migrate the server or deploy resources.
Minimize recurring cost without public data access, account keys or contributor access to production data.

properties.networkSecurityGroup: HTTPS from app subnet to private endpoint only; deny other inbound

reasoning.whyChosen: Separate delegated integration and private endpoint subnets protect data connectivity.
alternativesConsidered: Public storage endpoint with firewall rules
reasoning.tradeoffs: New standalone VNet; review address space before future peering.

reasoning.whyChosen: Lowest dedicated tier supporting regional VNet integration and Always On.
reasoning.tradeoffs: One instance, no zone redundancy; not a highly available production architecture.

reasoning.whyChosen: Public game HTTPS endpoint with outbound private data connectivity and passwordless service identity.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Stopped by default until server integration is ready. Public web/SCM endpoints are deliberate; no public storage.

reasoning.whyChosen: Low-volume entity storage without provisioned database throughput.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Table query limitations require a leaderboard index, ETag concurrency, session cleanup and explicit backup/recovery. LRS is not regional disaster recovery.

reasoning.whyChosen: Only private data-plane access from the integration VNet.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Private endpoint hourly/data-processing costs; management clients need private connectivity.

reasoning.whyChosen: Resolves the normal table endpoint to a private address for App Service.
reasoning.tradeoffs: New standalone zone, not intended to replace an organization's existing shared DNS.

reasoning.whyChosen: No storage keys, contributor data access or broad account-level management role.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Runtime remains trusted and can read all four tables; deployment authorization must be tightly controlled.

overallReasoning.summary: New resource-group-scoped infrastructure approved by the user; no existing Azure resources were supplied or inspected. Infrastructure only, with application disabled until the separate Table Storage adapter and migration pass acceptance.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: No Key Vault because there is no service credential to store. No Cosmos DB, managed identity client secret, Application Insights, Log Analytics, firewall, NAT or automated backup infrastructure is added. Platform logs remain available; monitoring, backups and recovery must be implemented before real accounts. B1/LRS reduce cost but do not provide zone/region HA. Public web ingress is required for community play; storage is private. All regional SKU availability, policy, quota and cost checks remain predeployment tasks.

plan.validation: Compile locally and test template invariants. Azure what-if, regional availability, permissions, policy and actual connectivity require an approved target subscription and have not been performed.
